lede: Wat Nakhot Luang accounts for 43 catalogued manuscripts. It clusters in Lampang (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (98%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (95%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (5%). Dated witnesses run 1722–1966 CE (41 of 43 carry a date).
